title: how do i use cWRP with Instantsearch widget?
body:
I have a page which contains links that open the same page again but with a different query, since the component remains the same, react will not unmount and mount back again.

I want the parameters to change when the same page is opened up with a different query.

Basically I want to trigger change of state programmatically in my cWRP.

I am using react-instantsearch beta 18
